fluff.overview: The Armed Forces of the Federated Suns integrate conventional infantry directly into their Regimental Combat Teams, assigning foot, mechanized, and jump platoons to work permanently alongside BattleMech and armored formations. Mechanized wheeled platoons ride wheeled transports that offer good speed on roads and developed terrain, making them well-suited to garrison duty on worlds with established infrastructure where rapid response matters more than cross-country capability. Supplementing their primary arms with shoulder-launched short-range missile systems, these platoons carry enough anti-armor punch to threaten light vehicles and damage exposed BattleMech components at close range.
